summary: Everbright Digital Holding Ltd., a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K disclosing that on September 25, 2026, Dr. Leung Chun Yip resigned as Chief Executive Officer and Mr. Guo Ming was appointed CEO, effective the same day. The board also appointed Mr. Guo and Mr. Yang Mengbiao as Executive Directors, with Mr. Guo serving as Chairman. The filing states Dr. Leung's resignation did not result from any disagreement with the board. No terms, prices, advisors, or special-situation mechanics were disclosed. Watch for subsequent 6-K filings on governance, strategy, or any related ownership changes.
